title: Group with Jeff Bezos advances negotiations for a stake in Liverpool
seoTitle: Jeff Bezos advances in purchase of 30% of Liverpool
subtitle: Consortium led by Amazon founder nears acquisition of roughly a third of the club's shares
excerpt: A consortium that includes Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is progressing talks to acquire roughly 30% of Liverpool, BBC Sport reports.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Group with Jeff Bezos advances negotiations for a stake in Liverpool

A consortium that includes Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is moving forward in talks to acquire about 30% of Liverpool's shares, according to BBC Sport.

The phrase "moving forward in talks" indicates that the parties have passed the initial contact stage and are now discussing more specific details of the potential transaction. In deals of this nature, financial aspects, governance structure, and approval criteria—often involving regulatory bodies or internal shareholder agreements—are typically evaluated.

A stake of roughly 30% represents a sizable slice that could give the investor influence over the club's strategic decisions. This influence may manifest in director appointments, investment policy setting, and approval of long‑term development plans. However, the exact extent of that influence depends on formal agreements that are yet to be defined.

Investors from the technology sector have shown interest in expanding their portfolios into the sports market, seeking synergies between brands, technology, and entertainment. Jeff Bezos's presence in this consortium reflects that diversification trend, even though the details of how the stake will be structured remain under negotiation.

To date, no definitive terms or timeline for completing the transaction have been disclosed. BBC Sport only reported that talks are advancing, leaving the next steps— which will determine whether the acquisition materializes—still open.

With information from BBC Sport.
